title: Class
wikitext:
A '''class''' is the primary adventuring style of a [[player character]]. A character's class determines the [[Ability|abilities]] and [[skill]]s they will gain throughout their adventures, and consequently the styles of play available to the character. It determines the types of [[Equipment|weapons and armor]] they can use, which [[attributes]] they will value (and how those attributes function), if they are the [[melee]], [[ranged]], or [[caster]] type, as well as what combat [[role]]s the character is suitable for. Class also reflects the background themes of a character: whether they have chosen to pursue the dark arts of the [[warlock]] or the [[Light|Holy Light]] of the [[paladin]]; the bloody honor of the [[warrior]] or the arcane knowledge of the [[mage]].
